title: Let your worth come from being held
summary: The humble are kept close and made inwardly rich by the Lord. Stand where grace holds you, not where status ranks you.
takeaway: Stand where grace holds you, not where status ranks you.
lifeApplication: Before fishing for reassurance, touch the sternum and slow the breath. Remember that the Lord keeps the humble servant close to His own heart.

source.shortMeaning: The humble are kept close and made inwardly rich by the Lord.
source.lifeApplication: Before asking the world who you are, remember whose child you already are.

evidence.coreClaim: The humble are kept close and made inwardly rich by the Lord.
evidence.turn: Stay humble enough to be kept close and cherished by the Lord.
